verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for a SaaS platform with Connect APIs. The only related evidence is a docs line about receiving and replying to Canva comments from any platform, plus a note that Connect APIs can sync comments; this implies some event delivery but never explicitly names webhooks or event subscriptions. Missing for 10: explicit webhook/event-subscription documentation, list of subscribable event types, signature verification and delivery/retry details, hands-on corroboration.
